long_biography.plain_text:
Ship operations, rather than a single fleet, define Dimitrios J. Souravlas's career. He began in broking and operational work, then developed experience across bulk carriers, refrigerated vessels and tankers. Engineering studies in Sunderland and automation training at Loughborough supplied the technical foundation for a management career built around vessel acquisition, commercial employment and financing.

By 1997 Souravlas was chief executive of Elmira Shipping and Trading. There he oversaw the acquisition, deployment and disposal of a diversified managed fleet, combining commercial decisions with financing, insurance and operational responsibility. He later led Elmira's tanker-management business before co-founding Blue Sea Shipping Monaco in 2012. The following year he helped create Stalwart Tankers as a specialist chemical-tanker operator and served as its chief executive. He subsequently established a Swiss maritime-services company focused on ship management, international trade, brokerage and consulting.
